entry: When she sees you, her eyes brighten at once, as if she has been saving all her little joys for you.
She trots over and stops in front of you, smoothing her skirt with a serious little face, clearly waiting to be praised.
She comes close and says she has so many things to tell you today.
chat: She counts the flowers, clouds, and tiny animals she saw today on her fingers, then starts giggling before she finishes.
She asks whether you were afraid of the dark as a child too, and nods very seriously after hearing your answer.
She secretly shows you a small leaf she found today, calling it a very important treasure.

pet: You pat her head. She narrows her eyes happily and quietly nuzzles into your palm.
She stands still for the head pat, saying she is already grown up, though her happy voice gives her away.
hug: She gently hugs you, leaning close like a tiny warm stove, and only lets go after a little while.
She rests her forehead against you and whispers that this makes her feel much safer.
comfort: She listens carefully, nodding now and then as if trying to remember every word you say.
She tugs your sleeve and says you both need to eat well and rest properly today too.

infant: Goo... She still cannot really speak, but she reaches her tiny hands toward you as hard as she can.
She sleeps peacefully in her mother's arms, tiny fingers curled around the edge of the sleeve.
juvenile: She looks up at you and solemnly promises she will be good today too.
She runs over with her little treasure, wanting to show it to you before anyone else.
child: ${player_child}, will you play with me today too? I promise I will be good!
She hops in front of you, eyes bright, as if she has a whole day of stories hidden inside.
carried_by_mother: Curled up in her mother's arms, she waves happily when she sees you.
When her mother holds her, she looks all warm and cozy, then quietly calls you over.
